decisions: 2026-11-10: use the English name a person is commonly known by where one exists (Puma Shen, Johnny Chiang, George Hsieh, Ann Kao, Eric Chu, James Soong, Apollo Chen, Frida Tsai, Justin Huang, Helen Chang); formal romanization otherwise.
Where sources disagree, keep the current choice: 張嘉郡 Chang Chia-chun (Legislative Yuan), 侯友宜 Hou Yu-ih, 劉增應 Liu Cheng-ying, 王惠美 Wang Huei-mei, 李文良 Lee Wen-liang (CNA).
A name with no English source: Hanyu Pinyin, hyphen between the given-name syllables (e.g. 朱秀珍 would be Zhu Xiu-zhen). None needed so far.
